symptom: `mxcli check nosuchsection.mdl -p App.mpr` → `Check passed!` for `alter settings nosuchsection (Foo: 1);` (and `alter settings webui (…)`, and any misspelled key such as `ExtraJvmParams`), then `mxcli exec` → `Error: unknown settings section: nosuchsection (expected model, configuration, constant, LANGUAGE, or workflows)` — a script passed the gate and stopped halfway through
cause: The grammar takes any IDENTIFIER as a settings section, and the only refusals of an unknown section, an unknown key, or a verb the section does not define (`workflows add 'x'`, `language add group`) lived in alterSettings' switch defaults. ValidateSettings only checked typed values and returned nil for a section without typed keys, so check had nothing to report
file: mdl/executor/validate_settings.go (settingsSectionKeys, settingsStatementErrors, unknownSettingsSection/Key/Keys, settingsStatementViolations — MDL-SET04; ValidateSettings, ValidateCreateConfiguration); mdl/executor/cmd_settings.go (alterSettings and createConfiguration call it first; configurationSettingKeys); tests mdl/executor/check_exec_agreement_settings_pedapp_test.go, TestSettingsSectionKeys_AllAccepted
insight: Make the key list the gate, not a mirror: exec calls the same project-independent function check reports (settingsStatementErrors) BEFORE reading the project, so a key given a switch case but not listed is refused by exec too and fails the feature's own test instead of a user's script — a mirrored table (like typedSettingsKeys) only stays honest via a drift test. The violation message is exec's first line verbatim; the valid-keys tail becomes the suggestion. Control: stubbing settingsStatementErrors to nil brings back `check` silent / exec refusing on the PedApp agreement test, and both .fail.mdl scripts pass `check` on the main build. createConfiguration said "unknown configuration property" where alter said "setting" — one message now. Section list in the message names `runtime` (MODEL is the deprecated alias) and webui. Scanned docs/skills/examples for statements using a key outside the lists: none (check-mdl 990 pass, check-skill-mdl pass). Check/exec disagreement recurs (~47 findings mention it) with no bug-patterns page of its own
